finsights.brief: Has raised its dividend for 4 consecutive years
Trading at a low P/E ratio relative to near-term earnings growth

summary: HKEX reported record H1 2026 revenue of HKD 16.7B (+19% YoY) and profit of HKD 10.6B (+24% YoY), beating EPS forecast by 18.33%.
Cash market daily turnover hit record HKD 283B (+18% YoY); Stock Connect, Bond Connect, and Swap Connect all reached new highs.
Hong Kong ranked second globally for IPOs with 105 listings and HKD 41B raised; derivatives and commodities volumes rose 6% and 18% respectively.
HKEX launched Five-Year China Government Bond futures and plans to accept CGBs as collateral in clearing houses by end-2026, pending approval.
Management plans to extend derivatives after-hours trading to U.S. hours; cash market extension under review with focus on market readiness.
